hr-cfo.departments.label: Manage departments
hr-cfo.departments.description: Official DTSC department reference used by staff, budgets, and transactions.

hr-cfo.accounts.label: Manage accounts
hr-cfo.accounts.description: Financial accounts used for inflows, outflows, budgets, and payroll payments.

hr-cfo.positions.label: Manage positions
hr-cfo.positions.description: Official DTSC position reference. CEO, COO, HR & CFO, SCO, CTO, and MPO business permissions rely on these codes.

hr-cfo.employees.label: Staff and HR records
hr-cfo.employees.description: HR records linked to existing internal members. Names and emails come from user accounts and cannot be edited here.

hr-cfo.budgets.label: Budgets and controls
hr-cfo.budgets.description: Budgets funded by active accounts. Creation is blocked when the account has insufficient available funds.

hr-cfo.transactions.label: Transactions
hr-cfo.transactions.description: DTSC financial transactions: inflows, outflows, accounts, budgets, approvals, and automatic invoices.

hr-cfo.payrolls.label: Payroll management
hr-cfo.payrolls.description: Payroll per employee and budget. Gross pay comes from the HR record and the account is derived from the budget.

sco.materialItems.label: DTSC material items
sco.materialItems.description: Central catalog of material goods used in inventory, assets, and equipment.

sco.vendors.label: Suppliers
sco.vendors.description: Supplier directory, reliability, average lead times, contacts, and payment terms.

sco.purchaseRequests.label: Purchase requests
sco.purchaseRequests.description: Operational needs, justification, budget, urgency, prospective supplier, and order status.

sco.inventory.label: Stock and inventory
sco.inventory.description: Items, quantities, minimum thresholds, locations, and periodic inventory counts.

sco.assets.label: Assets and equipment
sco.assets.description: IT equipment, printers, field equipment, assignments, condition, and maintenance.

sco.logistics.label: Missions and logistics
sco.logistics.description: Training, events, field missions, checklists, and operational risk preparation.

coo.operations.label: Internal operations
coo.operations.description: Cross-department activities: goals, deliverables, owners, progress, and priorities.

coo.tasks.label: Daily tasks
coo.tasks.description: Assign, track, approve, unblock, and document daily task execution.

coo.recurringTasks.label: Recurring tasks
coo.recurringTasks.description: Daily, weekly, or monthly task templates generated without duplication.

coo.departmentRequests.label: Interdepartmental coordination
coo.departmentRequests.description: Requests, dependencies, approvals, and expected responses between DTSC departments.

coo.blockers.label: Blocker tracking
coo.blockers.description: Operational blockers, severity, impact, corrective action, and resolution.

coo.meetings.label: Meetings and minutes
coo.meetings.description: Scheduling, decisions, attendees, generated tasks, and meeting minutes.

coo.workflows.label: Operational workflows
coo.workflows.description: Repeatable internal processes, steps, owners, and deadlines.

coo.reports.label: Operational reports
coo.reports.description: Daily, weekly, monthly, departmental, employee, and operation reports.

ceo.objectives.label: Objective tracking
ceo.objectives.description: DTSC executive objectives by period, department, owner, target, and progress.

ceo.supervisionLogs.label: Executive supervision log
ceo.supervisionLogs.description: Executive observations, decisions, instructions, risks, opportunities, and follow-ups.

mpo.projects.label: Project portfolio
mpo.projects.description: DTSC digital projects: scoping, owners, CTO/COO/HR & CFO/SCO involvement, risks, budgets, and deliverables.

mpo.records.label: MPO registers
mpo.records.description: Scoping, specifications, deliverables, risks, reports, workflows, documents, and budget or material needs.

cto.projects.label: Technical projects
cto.projects.description: Projects received or created by the CTO: analysis, development, testing, production, technology stack, repository, and deliverables.

cto.records.label: CTO registers
cto.records.description: Architecture, technical tasks, APIs, databases, deployments, security, bugs, documents, quality, and CTO reports.

legal.cases.label: Legal cases
legal.cases.description: Cross-functional legal cases: type, requester, legal owner, risk, priority, deadline, decision, and CEO arbitration.

legal.contracts.label: Contracts and agreements
legal.contracts.description: Customer, supplier, HR, consultancy, and other contracts with legal and CEO approvals linked to business sections.

legal.templates.label: Legal templates
legal.templates.description: Reference clauses, contracts, letters, mandates, NDAs, and approved DTSC templates.

legal.risks.label: Legal risks and compliance
legal.risks.description: Risk, impact, probability, corrective measures, owners, and CEO escalations.

legal.documents.label: Official documents and archiving
legal.documents.description: Secure archives for incorporation documents, RCCM, signed contracts, minutes, tax, social, and compliance records.

legal.disputes.label: Disputes and complaints
legal.disputes.description: Disputes involving customers, suppliers, staff, partners, administrations, technology, or finance.

legal.requests.label: Internal legal requests
legal.requests.description: HR & CFO, COO, CTO, MPO, SCO, and CEO requests to Legal for advice, approval, contracts, compliance, or litigation.

legal.reports.label: Legal reports
legal.reports.description: Weekly and monthly reports on contracts, risks, disputes, deadlines, and departmental requests.
